subject: Mutual Action Plan / Procurement onboarding — vendor setup checkpoints
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@clearlinehealth.com>, procurement@clearlinehealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual Action Plan / Procurement onboarding — vendor setup checkpoints

Claire / Clearline procurement team — thanks again for a productive discovery call earlier today. As promised, I pulled together a short MAP-style checklist focused on the vendor onboarding steps your procurement team asked about (Ariba/Coupa enrollment, tax forms, and banking authorization). The attached MAP-draft.xlsx is a one-page working plan — below are the key milestones with proposed owners and target dates. Please review and flag any missing dependencies.

High-level milestones (proposed)
- 1) Vendor record creation in Coupa/Ariba (dependency: vendor profile + tax docs) — owner: Clearline procurement (Mike) — target: 2026-11-24
- 2) W-9 submission and verification — owner: Clearline (vendor contact) / Redwood (sales ops verify receipt) — target: 2026-11-20
- 3) Bank account verification & ACH authorization (dependency: completed banking-authorization-form.pdf) — owner: Clearline finance — target: 2026-11-30
- 4) PO/contract setup & billing cadence confirmation — owner: Clearline procurement + Redwood legal — target: 2026-12-02

Open dependencies we discussed
- Which vendor portal do you prefer for onboarding (Ariba vs Coupa)? We included both vendor-form-coupa.xlsx and a generic map for Ariba in the Google Drive link.
- Banking details: does procurement require an independent ACH micro-deposit flow or will the banking-authorization-form be sufficient?
- DocuSign for SOW/PO terms: I can send an envelope once you confirm timeline.

Attachments (stubs): MAP-draft.xlsx (working MAP), Clearline_W-9.pdf (example W-9 we requested), vendor-form-coupa.xlsx (Coupa upload template), banking-authorization-form.pdf (bank template)

Next step / ask: can you confirm the primary procurement contact who will create the vendor record (name/email) and whether you want us to pre-populate vendor profile fields to accelerate Coupa/Ariba steps? If yes, we’ll share the CSV export for direct upload.

Thanks — I’ll keep the MAP in the shared Drive and update as we get approvals.

—
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0187

From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearlinehealth.com, Mike Bailey <mike.bailey@clearlinehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan / Procurement onboarding — vendor setup checkpoints

Sean — thanks for the clear recap and the MAP draft. A couple quick clarifications from our side before we confirm owners/timeline: 

1) Portal: we use Coupa primarily, but Ariba is used by some of our larger BU partners. For Clearline’s platform vendors we prefer Coupa. Please treat Coupa as the canonical flow.

2) W-9: we will provide the completed W-9 from our vendor legal contact. Can Redwood confirm if you need the signed PDF only or if we should upload the editable form into Coupa?

3) Banking / ACH: Clearline requires the banking-authorization-form and a micro-deposit verification step. Finance (cc: Mike Bailey) will handle the micro-deposits; Mike — can you confirm estimated turnaround (usually 3–5 business days for us).

4) PO timing: we typically issue a preliminary PO after vendor record + W-9 are validated. That would push contract/billing cadence items to ~2026-12-02 which looks fine.

I’ll confirm the internal owners by EOD tomorrow. Also — can you add a line item in the MAP for data residency/compliance questions? Some internal stakeholders will want to confirm logging/audit policy before PO.

Best,
Claire
Director, Vendor Management | Clearline Health
claire.huang@clearlinehealth.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>

Marissa / Rishi — forwarding Claire’s notes. Couple of internal asks so we can respond with a firm timeline: 

- Marissa: can your team prepare a Coupa upload CSV and a one-line guidance doc for the procurement admin? If we pre-fill fields (tax ID, remittance address, billing contact) it should speed their vendor creation.
- Rishi: finance needs the banking-authorization-form and should confirm our micro-deposit process. Can you provide the standard file and expected turnaround for verification? Also need a statement on how we store bank info (data residency/audit) to share with Clearline’s compliance folks.

I’ll update the MAP in Drive (link below) once you confirm. If we can get the W-9 and Coupa CSV ready by Friday (11/20) we can keep their target dates.
